detector_arm_caveat: IMPORTANT. The detector arm here is the RELEASED score column thresholded at 0.5, and it is NOT the arm tab:mcc reports as 'ACCORD at tau = 0.5'. They are different systems and they behave oppositely. The registered row at step3_baselines.json has cells tp 11, fp 223, fn 1, tn 18, a near-constant POSITIVE predictor with MCC -0.0070. The released column spans only 0.3061 to 0.5528, so a 0.5 cut flags 25 of 299 and gives cells tp 0, fp 23, fn 12, tn 218, a near-constant NEGATIVE predictor with MCC -0.0706. An earlier version of this file called that pair a digit transposition; it is not, it is two artifacts on different score scales. The paired bootstrap below can only be run against the released column, because that is the only detector artifact carrying a per-pair score for all 253 rows: predictions_253_core.csv holds the 12 positives only. So this comparison is labeller against the released detector, and no paired interval against the tab:mcc arm is computable from the retained record.
method: paired percentile bootstrap over pairs, B=10000, seed=42; both systems resampled together so their correlation on shared rows is preserved
